notes: DRAFT 13.11. for Wed 18.11. 18:00 (launch eve). Re-check on 18.11. against Newswire/Support. Tier 1: Rockstar Support 'regional pre-load and release times' (midnight local time Nov 19, all regions, PS5 + Xbox Series X|S), PlayStation Blog Nov 10 (rolling midnight launch from 12:00 AM NZDT), Rockstar Pre-Load FAQ (Rest Mode / Sleep mode + auto downloads), Newswire Nov 3 (up to 212 GB; free printable cover art poster + Leonida map on the official site on Nov 19). GMT values = midnight local converted (NZDT UTC+13, AEDT UTC+11, CET UTC+1, GMT, EST UTC-5, PST UTC-8). Dup check: preload post 10.11. tips.title: PRE-LOAD DONE?
tips.body: Up to 212 GB. PS5: auto-downloads on + Rest Mode. Xbox: auto updates on + Sleep mode.

tips.title: FREE LEONIDA MAP
tips.body: On launch day Rockstar adds a free printable map of Leonida + cover art poster to the official GTA VI site.
